takomo.subject: takomo
takomo.value: Finnish golf club maker (forged irons). Lives under Stick as a product_brand. Operating brand is stick.

products.subject: Takomo 101T
products.value: Takomo 101T entry forged iron. Model identity verified against official manufacturer catalogue (matches Iron 101T). Specific shaft/grip/loft specs are NOT in authoritative manufacturer docs in this knowledge store.
products.manufacturer_audit: Confirmed present on official manufacturer list (Iron 101, Iron 101T, Iron 101 MKII, Iron 201, Iron 201 MKII, Iron 201T MKII, Iron 301 CB, Iron 301 MB, Iron 301 Combo).

details.specs_note: Loft/lie/length/shaft/grip values have NOT been promoted to canonical product specs because the only available source (visual-spec/archetypes.json) is a visual_reference, not an authoritative manufacturer spec document. To ground product_spec claims (loft, lie, length, shaft, grip), supply an official_manufacturer source.

visual_references.note: Visual archetype example-prompt-seed mentions loft 28° | lie 59° | length 39" | shaft DG S300 | grip Tour Velvet. This describes a rendered hero card, NOT the universal Takomo 101T spec sheet. Useful for design rendering, NOT for product claims.
